summary: Little Bunchgrass L-5 ground cab, built 1933 per the register (1934 per local history), removed or destroyed in 1968; no current site description found.

facts.status_note: Removed in 1968 per the register and local history; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1968

events.note: Register and firelookout.com date the 10x10 L-5 cab to 1933. Local history dates the build to 1934.
Frank Singletary left to serve as lookout fireman (Eugene Guard, July 21, 1933).
Materials being sent for the lookout house (April 27, 1934). Local history says the 10x10 L-5 house was built in 1934.
Phillip Dimick serving as lookout fireman (Eugene Guard, August 8, 1938).
Register and local history: the lookout was removed.
firelookout.com says the cab was destroyed in 1968.
Registered on May 8, 2011 as FFLOS US 837, OR 222.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com date the cab to 1933. The local history reports a lookout fireman on the mountain in July 1933, materials sent in April 1934, and a lookout house built in 1934. The story reports both dates and does not pick one.
The register and the local history say the lookout was removed in 1968. firelookout.com says it was destroyed in 1968. The story uses removed and notes firelookout.com's wording.

notes_for_editor: No source describes the site today, so the story says so; access is left out. The register's scanned Dean Norman PDF (firetower.org/media/4205/dean-norman-book.pdf, 29 pages) has no text layer and no OCR tool is installed, so it was not read or quoted; it may cover the 1953 period. Brief's elevation (1618.8 m) matches the register's 1,619 m and is not changed. Two WebSearch calls used.
